blurb: Guests join an approximately hour-long hot air balloon flight just outside Portland, Oregon. They ascend slowly over the Willamette Valley, viewing wine country, mountain peaks, volcanoes, and the river below. The company has been flying in the region since 1989 and operates up to six balloons on a given day.
extraNote: Flights may be postponed or cancelled due to weather for safety · Group flights sold out for 2026 season; private flights limited
